asset_heavy.reason: Runs 14 cultivation/production facilities over 1,000,000 sq ft plus Zen Leaf and MÜV dispensaries requiring ongoing capital.

big_ticket.reason: Cannabis flower, vapes, edibles and balms are small, frequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cannabis consumables, including medicinal products, are habitual low-cost purchases that customers rarely postpone in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual dispensary shoppers and patients; wholesale goes to other dispensaries, not large enterprises.

notes: Verano is a vertically integrated cannabis operator; retail dispensaries and wholesale are both significant, with retail likely larger.

offers_products.reason: Grows and makes branded cannabis flower, vapes, edibles, topicals under Encore, Avexia, MÜV and Bits.

offers_services.reason: Dispensaries sell its goods at retail; no distinct service work is a main offering.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for cultivated and manufactured cannabis goods, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Consumable cannabis products bought repeatedly by dispensary customers and medical patients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Zen Leaf and MÜV dispensaries sell directly to adult-use customers and medical patients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale of Verano brands to third-party licensed dispensaries, which buy for resale.
